boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus places for studying, creating, gathering, and taking in University of Arkansas traditions, documented by current university sources.

cards.title: Settle into the Living Room Lounge
cards.subtitle: Arkansas Union, Level A3
cards.notes: Bring a classmate or your reading list, then use the couches, chairs, and tables for a low-key meeting or study break.
cards.short_summary: A furnished Union lounge set up for meeting and studying between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Arkansas Union Student Activities identifies the Living Room Lounge on A3 as a place with couches, chairs, and tables where students meet and study.
cards.source_title: Student Activities | Arkansas Union | University of Arkansas
cards.access_notes: Located on A3 in the Arkansas Union; confirm building access before visiting.

cards.title: Pause in the International Connections Lounge
cards.subtitle: Arkansas Union
cards.notes: Use a small table overlooking the patios and campus for conversation, a brief reset, or an event listed by the Union.
cards.short_summary: A Union lounge with tables and campus-facing views that also hosts events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Union says the International Connections Lounge has small tables looking out on patios and campus and hosts events such as games and performances.
cards.source_title: Student Activities | Arkansas Union | University of Arkansas
cards.access_notes: Inside the Arkansas Union; event use and access can affect availability.

cards.title: Walk the Union Mall
cards.subtitle: Between Arkansas Union and Mullins Library
cards.notes: Take the route between the Union and Mullins Library, and check whether a campus organization has reserved a table or outdoor event.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor stretch linking the Union, fountain area, and Mullins Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arkansas Union defines Union Mall as the large area extending from the Union front to Mullins Library and reserves information tables there.
cards.source_title: Event Venues | Arkansas Union | University of Arkansas
cards.access_notes: Outdoor events and information tables may be reserved; keep clear of scheduled activities.

cards.title: Check the Union Theater schedule
cards.subtitle: Arkansas Union
cards.notes: Look for a public play, ceremony, performer, or movie showing, and plan around weekday classes that also use the theater.
cards.short_summary: A 247-seat Arkansas Union venue for performances, films, ceremonies, and classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Union describes Union Theater as a 247-capacity venue for plays, ceremonies, performers, and movie showings, with weekday class use.
cards.source_title: Event Venues | Arkansas Union | University of Arkansas
cards.access_notes: Programming and classes determine availability; check the Union’s event calendar before going.

cards.title: See what is on view at Anne Kittrell Gallery
cards.subtitle: Arkansas Union
cards.notes: Stop by during an exhibition, then contact the Multicultural Center if you need current details about receptions or gallery programming.
cards.short_summary: An Arkansas Union gallery used primarily for art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arkansas Union identifies Anne Kittrell Gallery as a space generally used for art exhibitions and directs visitors to the Multicultural Center for information.
cards.source_title: Event Venues | Arkansas Union | University of Arkansas
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and receptions vary; contact the Multicultural Center for current gallery information.

cards.entity_name: Mullins Library Level 3 Quiet Study Areas
cards.title: Choose Level 3 for quiet study
cards.subtitle: David W. Mullins Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Bring individual work to Level 3 and keep calls elsewhere; this floor is designated for quiet study under the library’s room-use guidance.
cards.short_summary: The designated quiet-study level in the university’s main library.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries states that Level 3 in Mullins Library is designated for quiet study.
cards.source_title: Mullins Library Renovation | University of Arkansas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use during library open hours and observe the quiet-study designation.

cards.entity_name: Mullins Library Level 4 Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Book a Level 4 group-study room
cards.subtitle: David W. Mullins Library, Level 4
cards.notes: Coordinate a project group, reserve an eligible room with a current UARK email, and bring a device if you need to use a display.
cards.short_summary: Reservable collaboration rooms on the library’s group-work level.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries designates Mullins Level 4 for collaboration and group work and lists reservable group-study rooms there.
cards.source_title: Mullins Library Renovation | University of Arkansas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservations are limited to current UARK affiliates and are valid only while the library is open.

cards.title: Make something at AR Creation Studios
cards.subtitle: Mullins Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Explore the makerspace or media studios for an academic or personal project, and check with the studio for equipment and session details.
cards.short_summary: A Level 2 Mullins Library hub for hands-on media, making, and immersive-project work.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries says AR Creation Studios in Mullins Library provides hands-on learning for academic and personal projects through multiple studios and a makerspace.
cards.source_title: Service Locations | University of Arkansas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 2 of Mullins Library; check studio availability and requirements before starting a project.

cards.title: Read in the Walton Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Mullins Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Use the reading room when you want a focused library session, then consult the library floor plan for its exact Level 2 location.
cards.short_summary: A named reading room among Mullins Library’s Level 2 study and service spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists the Walton Reading Room on Level 2 of Mullins Library, and the university catalog describes it as a quiet study area.
cards.source_title: Library Maps, Locations, and Directions | University of Arkansas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 2 of Mullins Library; visit during library open hours.

cards.title: Read the names on Senior Walk
cards.subtitle: University of Arkansas campus sidewalks
cards.notes: Follow the sidewalk inscriptions and look for graduates’ names, beginning with the university’s first graduating class of 1876.
cards.short_summary: A campus sidewalk tradition recording University of Arkansas graduates’ names.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Arkansas describes Senior Walk as sidewalks bearing graduate names, beginning with the first graduating class of 1876.
cards.access_notes: An outdoor campus feature; follow normal pedestrian guidance and any event-area restrictions.
